bifrost: springboard/ui/src/widget.rs and springboard/ui/src/widget_list.rs (pure widget models); springboard/src/shell/today.rs and springboard/src/shell/widgets/mod.rs (shell-internal Today View widgets); springboard/src/shell/notify/center.rs (Notification Center column, system UI only); no app-facing widget API in springboard/sdk/src/
summary: The framework is a set of Today-widget extension classes (NCWidgetProviding, NCWidgetController, search and list view controllers). Apple's landing page marks it deprecated in favour of WidgetKit. BifrOSt now has pure models for the display modes and margin insets, the has-content flag and the list rows, but no app can yet supply a Today widget, so the models are not reachable from an app and the search view is still missing.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/widget.rs (DisplayMode, Insets, margin_insets, Limits); springboard/src/shell/widgets/mod.rs (fixed Kind list rendered into tiles by the shell); springboard/src/shell/today.rs (Today View page)
features.note: The display modes, the maximum size per mode and the margin choice are modelled in bifrost-ui. Not yet wired: no SDK type, no update callback (widgetPerformUpdate) and no shell call into the model. The shell's own widgets are fixed and apps cannot supply one.

The has-content flag and the filter that hides empty widgets are modelled. Not yet exposed to apps through bifrost_app and not used by the Today View. A widget that never reports stays visible (BifrOSt choice, not documented by Apple).

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/today.rs (Edit button: switch widgets off and drag them into order, saved in today.ini); springboard/src/shell/widgetgallery.rs (Add Widget sheet, Small and Medium sizes)
features.note: The shell edits its own widget list. Per-widget editing hooks for apps are missing; the widget gallery is also not exposed to apps.

features.apple: NCWidgetSearchViewController: delegate, searchDescription, searchResultsPlaceholderString, searchResultKeyPath, searchResults; NCWidgetSearchViewDelegate
features.note: The Today View has a search bar for the shell's own use (springboard/src/shell/today.rs header). No app-facing search results view exists. Spotlight-style search is a separate surface (see the quicksearch SDK module in springboard/sdk/src/). Fuzzy matching for a results list exists in springboard/ui/src/fuzzy.rs but is not wired to a widget.

features.apple: NCWidgetListViewController: contents, row(for:), viewController(atRow:makeIfNecessary:), minimumVisibleRowCount, hasDividerLines, editing, showsAddButtonWhenEditing; NCWidgetListViewDelegate
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/widget_list.rs (WidgetList: contents, row_for, item_at, visible_rows, add_button_visible, delete); springboard/src/shell/today.rs and springboard/src/shell/notify/center.rs (shell-side lists)
features.note: The row model, minimum visible row count, editing gate and Add button rule are modelled. Missing: drawing of the list, the per-row content view controller (makeIfNecessary), the delegate, and an app-facing SDK type.

features.feature: Notification list in the system column
features.apple: Not part of this framework. Apple's user-facing Notification Center is system UI; apps post notifications through UserNotifications.
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/notify/center.rs (column of glass cards, one per app, clear per app or all); springboard/src/shell/notify/mod.rs (Notification Center in the notification store); springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs (app-facing UNUserNotificationCenter-style API)
features.note: The column and delivery exist and apps can post through usernotif. Widgets are left out of the column (center.rs comment: the shell has no widget data source on the PC yet). Included only for context: it is not an API of this framework.

features.apple: Landing page: 'Deprecated. Use WidgetKit instead.' (macOS 10.10+, iOS 8.0+, Mac Catalyst 8.0+). See https://developer.apple.com/documentation/notificationcenter
features.bifrost: none (WidgetKit is not implemented on BifrOSt)
features.note: Parity for the deprecated framework should be judged against WidgetKit, which is outside this row. Apple itself points new work there.

gaps: No app-facing Today widget extension point: the widget models in springboard/ui/src/widget.rs and widget_list.rs are not exposed through bifrost_app, so apps cannot supply widget content to the Today View or the home-screen gallery.
The has-content controller and the display-mode model are not wired into the Today View; the shell does not yet hide empty widgets or switch display modes.
No search results view for widgets (NCWidgetSearchViewController) and no drawing for the list view (NCWidgetListViewController); the per-row content controller and the delegate callbacks are missing.
widgetPerformUpdate (the update callback) and the editing callbacks widgetDidBeginEditing and widgetDidEndEditing have no BifrOSt counterpart.
The Notification Center column does not show widgets: springboard/src/shell/notify/center.rs says the shell has no widget data source on the PC yet.
WidgetKit (Apple's replacement) is not in the SDK; it is outside this framework but is where Apple's widget work now lives.
